# infisical_app_connection_adcs (Resource)

Create and manage Microsoft ADCS App Connection. For setup, see the [Microsoft ADCS app connection guide](https://infisical.com/docs/integrations/app-connections/adcs). Requires Infisical v0.161.14 or later.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    infisical = {
      # version = <latest version>
      source = "infisical/infisical"
    }
  }
}

provider "infisical" {
  host = "https://app.infisical.com" # Only required if using self hosted instance of Infisical, default is https://app.infisical.com
  auth = {
    universal = {
      client_id     = "<machine-identity-client-id>"
      client_secret = "<machine-identity-client-secret>"
    }
  }
}

resource "infisical_app_connection_adcs" "app-connection-adcs" {
  name   = "adcs-app-connection"
  method = "username-password"
  credentials = {
    host     = "ca01.corp.example.com"
    username = "CORP\\svc-infisical"
    password = "<password>"
  }
  # project_id   = "<project-id>" # Optional, only required if you want to scope the app connection to a specific project
  gateway_id  = "<gateway-id>" # Required, Microsoft ADCS connections reach the AD CS server through a gateway
  description = "I am a test app connection"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `credentials` (Attributes) The credentials for the Microsoft ADCS App Connection (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--credentials))
- `method` (String) The method used to authenticate with Microsoft ADCS. Possible values are: username-password
- `name` (String) The name of the Microsoft ADCS App Connection to create. Must be slug-friendly

### Optional

- `description` (String) An optional description for the Microsoft ADCS App Connection.
- `gateway_id` (String) The Gateway ID to use for the app connection. Microsoft ADCS connections can only reach the host through a gateway, so set either `gateway_id` or `gateway_pool_id`.
- `gateway_pool_id` (String) The ID of the gateway pool to use for the app connection, instead of a single gateway. Microsoft ADCS connections can only reach the host through a gateway, so set either `gateway_id` or `gateway_pool_id`. Gateway pools require an Infisical Enterprise plan. Requires Infisical v0.159.29 or later.
- `project_id` (String) The ID of the project to scope the app connection to. If not provided, the app connection will be scoped to the organization.

### Read-Only

- `credentials_hash` (String) The hash of the Microsoft ADCS App Connection credentials
- `id` (String) The ID of the app connection

<a id="nestedatt--credentials"></a>
### Nested Schema for `credentials`

Required:

- `host` (String) The host name, FQDN or IP address of the AD CS server, as the gateway resolves it, for example `ca01.corp.example.com`.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) The password of the Windows account.
- `username` (String) The Windows account used for enrollment, in the form `DOMAIN\user` or `user@domain`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# This will import the Microsoft ADCS app connection by its ID.
# Secrets are never read back, so the first apply after importing sends the credentials in the configuration.
terraform import infisical_app_connection_adcs.example <app_connection_id>
```
